༄༅/ /zhwa lu skyogs ston gyis mdzad pa'i dag yig li shi'i gur khang / /༈/namomañdzushrīye/de yang 'dir brda gsar rnying gi tha snyad bshad pa la/thu mi sa

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /zhwa lu skyogs ston gyis mdzad pa'i dag yig li shi'i gur khang // ༈ /namomañdzushrīye/ de yang 'dir brda gsar rnying gi tha snyad bshad pa la/ thu mi sa 'bo ra dang / btsad po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus dang por byas pa'i 'gyur rnams ni/ dang po'i bkas bcad kyis bsgyur ba ste/ sangs rgyas phal po che dang / lung sde bzhi dang / mdo sde kha cig dang sher phyin gyi mdo kha cig ste/ skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la ma phab pa rnams so/ /de la ni/ gang la gag dang / ci phyir la ji rob dang / ji snyam la ji ltar dang / rtse mo la spyi bo dang / shin tu'am rab tu la te por dang / yang / wāḍhaṃ zhes pa bsgyur ba'i te por ni/ dam pa dang / sra ba dang / drag pa dang / tshabs che ba rnams la 'jug pa/ rkyen sman la rkyen rtsi dang / ltag pa la glag pa dang / spos dang spos phor la pog dang pog phor dang / bsal ba la bstsal ba dang / sogs pa la stsogs pa dang / bsu ba la bstsu ba dang / dri bsung la dri bstsung dang / bsangs pa la bstsangs pa dang / rdzogs so la rdzogs s+ho/ /g.yogs pa la yogs pa dang / go cha la go ca dang / brag cha la brag ca dang / rin po che la rin po ce dang / dkon mchog la dkon cog dang / rin chen la rin cen dang / khyim la sdum pa dang / dbus la dbung dang / 'gro ba la bgom pa dang / grub pa la red pa dang / 'grel ba la 'grol bar bsgyur ba la sogs pa mang ste/ rgyas par ni gsung rab las shes par bya'o/ /yang / de dag tu da drag dang / dpyid slar ba sogs dang / de' la' ni' zhes pa lta bu 'a yig mtha' rten sbyar ba ni sum rtags kyi dgongs pa yin kyang don la thob pa gzhir bcas nas yi ge nyung ba'i slad du bzhag pa dang / yang / myed/ myin sogs ya btags pa dang / ral gyi sogs ni lo tsā ba kha cig gi yul skad shor bar grags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skad gsar bcad la ni de dag gi zlas drangs pa ji skad bshad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gsung rab la grags pa'i ming phal che ba rnams so/

/bkas bcad gnyis po de ni mnga' bdag khri ral pa can yan chad du ska cog zhang gsum la sogs pas mdzad pa yin no/ /bkas bcad gsum pa ni lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus kyi sgra sgyur lo tsā ba chen po rin cen bzang po nas dpang lo tsā ba chen po dang snyigs dus kyi skad gnyis smra ba gcig pu pa lo chen dharma pālabhadra'i bar du byon pa rnams yin la/ lo chen gyis ni/ gnyi zla la nyi zla dang bstan bcos la bstan chos dang / stug po la 'thug po dang / nyi shu dang sum cu dang sum brgya rnams la/ gnyis bcu dang gsum bcu dang gsum brgya dang / bsam gtan la bsam btan sogs 'chos par mdzad kyang / bkas bcad bar pa bzhin du gnas pa mang zhing / de dag gi brda'i khyad par gsung rab rnams su 'byung ba 'di snyed cig mchis te/ kwa dang gag ni kye dang gang / skyor skyor ni yang yang / bla 'og ni steng 'og bla skyal ba ni mi zad pa/ rtsa lag ni gnyen/ gnya' bo ni dbang po/ rid pa dang speg pa ni dngos ngan pa dang sha chung ba'am skem pa/ gya ba ni nyams pa/ gyag pa ni brlag pa/ ye 'byam ni stong nyid/ dbal ni tog dang rtse mo dang sha nyams dang me'i drod ni snang ngo / /yo ni nye 'khor/ dmus byung ni tshi chad dam yi chad/ then cher ni ca re/ gzhad ni bzhad gad kyi sgra/ ya lang ni go cha spyi dang skabs thob kyis rmog gi ming la 'jug pa'ang yod/ gna' ni thog ma'am sngon/ yod do cog dang 'gyur ro cog lta bu'i cog ni mtha' dag gi don/ gyur cig gu lta bu'i gu ni smon pa'i tshig sbrebs pa ni skems pa/ gsang khung ni bshang lam/ mdung dor ni rgyan 'gyed/ cham du ni gtan du/ nod pa ni thob pa'am bzhag pa/ tha tshig ni tshig gi don/ bsti ba ni ngal gso ba/ brnag pa ni bsam pa/ smyang pa ni brkyang ba/ nam zhar ni nam yang / 'on tang ni 'on kyang / bkri ba ni drang ba'am 'khrid pa/ dbrag ni bar/ gzags pa ni zags pa/ phyam phyad ni mnyam nyid/

bgro ba ni gleng ba/ rmag chad ni yang dag pa'am phal po che dang snyan gyi gong rgyan/ bstar pa ni byi dor legs pa dang gzabs pa dang spras pa dang / sems la sgom pa dang yod pa la/ gting phyin pa ni dpyis phyin pa/ bro ni mna'/ chang khyu ni tshogs pa/ spa lo ni spobs pa/ tha ram ni ngan pa/ brnyang ba ni 'khru ba/ dbye ni thang / bsnyil ba ni dor ba'am phyir skrad pa/ lag pa bsnyal ba ni lag pa bkrus pa/ mthong ga ni brang / glam pa ni snam bu 'thug po/ khra khro can ni spro thung ba/ rud khus ba ni gtum pa/ mgo nan ni thog ma/ je ni dang po dang re zhig ces pa la'ang / gzhi bo ni gzhi ma/ ji 'os ni 'tsham pa/ gnod mi bkur ba ni nyes pa khas mi len pa/ bsgo brnar gzon pa ni bsgo ba la mi nyan pa/ 'chab pa ni gsang ba'am sbed pa/ 'dzan dka' ni sbyor dka'/ 'khu ba ni zhe sdang ba/ bcabs pa ni sbas pa/ gya tsom ni ma brtags pa/ rna blags ni rna ba gtod pa/ tha chad pa ni ngan pa/ stsel ba ni sel ba/ 'phye ba ni 'gro ba/ smreng tshig ni gsang tshig dang smra ba tsam la'ang / smreng ba ni smra ba/ smre ba ni ngan par smra ba/ smre sngags kyang de nyid/ rmas pa ni dris pa/ mi 'jab pa ni rtsub pa/ dral ba ni bcom pa'am zhig pa/ bla mthang ni stod smad dam phyi nang / bsod pa ni bzang po'am legs pa/ bstabs pa ni brims pa'am byin pa/ stob pa ni 'brim pa'am ster ba/ stob pa ni mgron du gnyer ba/ byer ba ni song ba/ brta ba ni rgyas par bya ba/ brtas pa ni rgyas pa/ da ko ni da ni/ 'di ko ni 'di ni/ bkon pa ni khro ba/ ji ga ni brtag pa/ khyo shug ni bza' tsho/ gzhol ba ni 'bab pa/ nyis na ni rnams pa gnyis su na zhes pa lta bu'am/ yang na/ tha ba ni rengs pa/ mthar gyis ni rim gyis/ gzhar yang ni slar yang ngam nam yang / mnos pa ni bsams pa/ gya nom ni phun sum tshogs pa/ gya nom snang ba ni yod pa dang legs pa'i don yang yin/ phyad par ni rgyun par/ bsnams pa ni thogs pa/

sha dag ni sha stag 'jud pa ni 'jug pa/ rngub pa ni 'dus pa'am 'jug pa/ tsham ngam ni 'jigs stangs/ bab bab bam bab col ni ma bsam par smra ba'am 'phral ma/ phyang yar ni 'phrin las/ snam logs ni zur dang rgyab/ snrel zhi ni logs sam 'phred dam 'chol pa go rims su mi gnas pa/ nyod pa ni zas/ rong pa ni gos/ yongs ye ni nges par/ rnam pa kun tu'am rnam thams cad kyi thams cad du zhes pa lta bu/ bstir med ni mnar med dam ngal gso med pa/ spribs pa ni ltogs pa/ bru ba tsha ba ni bkres pa/ bas pa ni zad pa'am mtha' dag pa/ brnan pa ni nges bzung / ram shag ni 'byor ba/ mnangs ni nom pa'am srid/ mtha' gru dang thag gru ni rgya khyon/ gnab rtsal ni kha zas/ g.yer po ni mkhas pa'am grims pa/ khos rang chab mi 'tshal ba ni mdun ma chud mi za ba'o/ /bskyud pa ni brjed pa/ khad kyi ni dal bu/ byur ni mya ngan/ yol go ni snod/ bsnyengs pa ni 'jigs pa/ bsnyems pa ni nga rgyal/ yug pa dang yob yob ni rkang pa/ sug pa ni lag pa/ nem nur ni yid gnyis/ rgya cang ni ska rags/ gur bu ni gru bzhi/ gyi na dang gyin 'dar ni dman pa'am don med dam rang bzhin ngan pa/ brtad pa ni glo bur pa/ mi yogs pa ni mi khebs pa/ 'ubs pa ni 'dus pa/ khung pa ni skyes sam rdzongs/ slags pa ni bkod pa/ phyang chad ni thag bcad/ la gor ni mgyogs pa'am skyen pa/ mur 'dug ni mu stegs/ co 'dri ni mtho 'tsham/ gzher ba ni bsten pa/ yel 'phyos ni zung 'jug 'chos pa ni bzos pa/ 'du 'phrod ni tshogs pa/ phya le ba ni mnyam pa/ chib pa ni khyab pa/ khos pa ni 'dun pa/ ngo mthon ni nan gyi/ mol pa ni gtam mam gros/ tshud mo mkhan ni rkos mkhan/ go 'dun ni tshogs shing 'du ba/ gzhur brtag ni zur zab/ nyer bsdogs ni sta gon/ myag phran ni mda'/ gor ma chag pa ni the tshom med pa/ gor ma bkum pa'ang de nyid/ gnam ru ni gzhu/ sprug pa ni zad pa/ bkar btags ni khrims bsgrags pa/

phung krol ni don med pa/ lhags pa ni gtad pa/ phyar g.yeng ni rnam g.yeng dang rang nyid 'dod pa'i chos gzhan la ngom zhing sgeg pa'i don yang yin/ sgam pa ni zab pa/ bgam pa ni nyams sad pa/ mnabs pa ni gyon pa/ rtseg log ni phran tshegs sam sred zhen che ba/ tshar phyin ni mthar phyin/ dbab pa ni 'bebs pa'am bzhag pa/ gzas pa ni brdeg par brtsams pa/ phon po ni tshogs pa/ 'dzer ba ni smras pa'am zer ba/ 'chel ba ni zhen pa'am 'chang ba/ tha rams ni gtams pa/ phyis bu ni snod/ rtser phyibs ni mthar phyin/ glal ba ni kha gdangs sam rnam par bsgyings pa/ klubs pa ni phub pa'am gyon pa/ g.yem pa ni 'dod pa/ mu cor ni kha zer ba dang kha drag gnam po ni drang po/ 'jug par kye ma gzhan gyi gnam po nyid ces pa lta bu'o/ /khor zug ni khor yug chabs cig pa ni lhan cig pa/ chub pa ni rtogs pa/ go 'dun ni sna tshogs sam gang mos/ mong du chud pa ni khong du chud pa/ rlibs pa ni rgya che ba/ mchil pa ni lcags kyu/ lcags kyo zhes pa'ang de nyid/ 'gyed pa ni 'gyod pa/ zang zing ni sha'am zas/ zang zing gi sbyin pa'ang gtso bor sha ster ba'i don du bshad/ 'gyer ba ni spong ba/ ger ma ni rags pa/ rum ni lto ba'am phag phom pa ni bum pa/ rton pa ni 'dod pa'am rjes su 'brang ba/ don la ni mi rton tshig la rton/ 'phyo ba ni lding ba/ 'gems pa ni 'joms pa/ snyugs su ni yun du/ dbrog pa ni 'phrog pa/ glebs pa ni mnan pa/ rjen pa ni gcer bu'am rkyang pa/ gal gyis ni nan gyis sam rgyal gyis/ 'jen pa ni len pa dang bcags pa dang dngos po yid dang rna bar 'thad pa lta bu la'ang yod/ rlugs pa ni lug pa ste zas ma zhu ba phyir byung ba/ nongs pa ni nyes pa/ 'phye bo ni gong po'am yan lag med par lto bas 'gro ba/ tshur sheg ni tshur shog lce rten ni brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/ sribs pa ni bsgribs pa'am grib ri dang mtshan mo/ slog pa ni pags pa'i gos/

sdod pa ni 'phen pa/ khol ma'am ba glang mig ni skar khung / 'di dkar gsal dang mun dkar zer ba dang bstun na das 'phul thob bar snang yang / 'dul ba la skar tshod blta ba'i ri mig bzhag pa las btags pa'i brda brtsan par byas pa'o/ /'grems pa ni 'gyed pa/ gseg shang dang gsil byed ni 'khar gsil/ spyi tor can ni gtsug tor can/ gsong por smra ba ni sngar smra ba'am drang por smra ba/ do ker can ni thor cog can/ dpe mkhyud ni chos ston 'os pa la'ang sba ba/ 'bel ba'i gtam dang bka' mchid ni yang dag pa'i gtam/ mkhyud spyad ni man ngag phran bu sbas te 'chad pa/ mur thug ni mthar thug phol ba ni rtogs pa/ la zlas pa ni thag bcad pa/ la zlo ba ni mtha' 'gegs pa'am thag bcod pa/ mi cha pa ni mi shes pa/ cha med ni rgyus med/ gtol med pa ni thabs med pa'am rgyus med pa/ ci gar ni ji ltar/ ci chib ni mthar phyin/ gar cig ni gang zhig smyan ka ni gnyen ka 'bags pa ni nyams pa/ dmun pa ni blun pa/ sho be ni rdzun/ shob kyang de nyid/ shid zan ni ro zan nam gshin zas sam dad zas/ shid ni gshin po la dmigs pa'i dge ba bsgrub pa/ phru ma ni pho brang ngam dmag sgar/ spong ba ni rtse pa/ brtun pa ni brtson pa/ sgo 'phar ni sgo glegs/ spyos pa ni sdigs pa'am khros pa/ snyom pa ni g.yel ba'am snyom las/ dbye tshong ni tshong khang / thang la ni bkram pa/ bslan pa ni bsdus phyogs gtogs/ tshog phor ni rdzogs par/ bdar ba ni bcad pa'am gzhogs pa/ gzegs pa ni brkyang pa'am gzi byin/ 'cheg pa ni 'jig pa/ glos pa ni rmongs pa/ rmeg med ni gtan med/ g.yen spyo ba ni ci dri'am sdang bar byed pa/ g.yam ni zhar/ rmed pa ni gsol ba/ slong phor ni lhung bzed/ bya ma rta ni nyan rna'am bang chen/ dpur ni sreg gnas/ bsel ba ni skyel ma'am 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ gtsug lag ni sde snod/ bsod nyams ni 'dod pa la lhag par longs spyod pa'i ming /

bsnyad pa ni bshad pa/ go re ni rdzogs pa/ brlang po ni rtsub po/ gzhogs stegs ni zur mig gam sgeg chos/ shur bu ni ska rags/ 'dzan mo ni bgrod bya ste bud med/ 'jud mthun dang 'dod 'gro dang gzugs 'tshong ni smad 'tshong / lag gi bla ni las de dang de la bskos pa/ 'dzen po ni bgrod byed de skyes pa/ ska rags phog gu can ni ska rags rgyan can/ 'thab krol ni gnod rgyu/ 'gre ba ni g.yo ba/ do zan ni mching bu/ lcags phod ni ska rags kyi rgyan/ khong snyom pa ni yid mi dga' ba'am sgyid lug pa/ dkyus mo ni mgyogs pa'am rgyug pa/ dang la ni rdzing bu/ klam pa ni la ba/ dam rgya ni khrims/ zha sgra ni rna med/ ltag sgre ni ltag ther/ gor mo ni sdang sems/ rna sbrang ni mde'u/ bshug pa ni bslang ba/ pus mkhyud ni sgom thag g.yar ni kha'am gdong ngam mdun/ hwags ni bu ram gyi dngas ma'i sha kha ra ste 'grel pa zla zer du gal la zhes kyang grags pa/ thags ran ni btags pa/ rmas pa ni nyams pa/ mnga' ni mthu/ dngar ni gral lam phreng ba/ gsug ni rngan pa/ brngan zhes pa ni mchod pa/ rnam 'dal ni rnam 'dud/ 'gyed pa ni gtong ba/ dbres pa ni brjes pa/ bsen khus pa ni gnyen bslus pa/ brgyad bkag ni kha smras sam bkyon pa/ 'o ni ni pa ni zhus pa'am dris pa/ po zos kyang ni ji ltar thogs kyang zhes pa ste yul skad la po mtho yang zer/ spyon pa ni 'bod ba'i brda chung shog ces pa lta bu'o/ /byon ces pa sleb zin pa'i don te ding sang brda nor mang / 'brongs pa ni nye bar bsten pa/ bshes spring du mtho ris bu mos 'brongs shing zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mi slon ni mi zlogs/ smag ni mun pa/ go ra ni btson ra/ ya ma brla ni snying po med pa'am mi bden pa/ slad rol ni phyi rol/ chang thub ni gang zag dog ma ni mdun/ gel pa ni yal ga 'phag pa'am cha ba ni 'jug pa/ ran pa ni lcag phran/ reng bu ni 'brel med dam rkyang pa/

mi 'gong ni mi zhum/ than kor ni nye 'khor/ bog re ni ba gam/ ma ltes pa ni ma legs pa/ stes dbang ni stobs shugs/ gna' ba ni sngon/ sna bo ni gtso bo/ mi gu ni mi zhum/ nye'u gyi ni bcud tshor/ nyen ni rmang / pe no ni 'dzin pa/ sro gang ni khrus/ dku mnye/ dril phyi/ me/ stan rnams kyi ming / 'di la bsro khang zhes pa'ang snang / jeng ni rgyud mangs sam dbyangs/ rmang lam ni rmi lam/ gya tho ni rna rgyan/ lan lon ni lan slon/ gdong mo ni mjug do'i nang / rnil nad ni so rnyil nad/ rngub re ni hub re/ chu drub pa ni khol ba'am rba glong / nyug rum ni rlig phyung ste btsun mo'i 'khor du 'byung ba/ zhogs ma ni steng g.yogs/ gzha' ba ni mgu ba/ gzha' tshon ni 'dza' tshon/ bskyang pa ni bsad pa'am 'gren pa/ phyi bi ni phyi rol/ pha bi ni pha rol/ dgon dung ni chu med pa/ tsha sgo can ni ba tsha can/ mong brtul ni blun po/ lung bong dang ban klang ni ba glang / phol mig ni 'khor lo/ mtshun ni lha'am pha mes/ 'ches pa ni khas len pa/ 'phe'u ni gsol ba/ gzha' gsang ni g.yung drung ngam 'phrin las/ dam dem ni dam bca'/ phyang sprul ni rgyan nam spud pa/ dbu rmog ni dbu 'phang / yid smo ni yid dga'/ gnyi zer ni nye zer/ sbon pa ni za ba/ rnyong ba ni brkyong ba/ 'byer ba ni 'gro ba/ 'drid pa ni slu ba/ gzod ma ni dang po/ ril ni thams cad/ gze ba ni gur/ klong du gyur pa ni dbang du gyur pa/ bcibs pa ni zhon pa/ mi bzad pa ni drag po drag shul mi sdug pa/ gcam bu ni bcos ma/ brkam pa ni 'dod zhen/ brkam chags ni 'dod chags che ba/ 'chobs shig ni gsongs shig gnyod ka ni 'khos ka g.yung ba ni zhan pa/ brtun nges pa lum dang rang bzo/ gzhib pa ni 'jib pa/ glags pa ni 'jug pa'am 'gro mtshams/ dong ste ni song ste/ 'dong ba ni 'gro ba/ dpen pa ni mkho ba'am 'phangs pa'am yid du 'ong ba/ btsog po ni pho btsog

rnyong ni gal/ jis na ni cis na/ tal la ni sgron me/ bsnyungs pa ni nyung ngur byas pa/ bsnyen sring ni nye ring / sbang byed ni rdo ba/ kos thag ni nyam thag snga mkho ni sngar bzhin/ smyur te ni myur du/ 'on cig byon cig ldem po ni drang po min pa/ nying tor ni nges par/ byos shig ni gyis shig rangs pa ni dga' ba dang ril po/ khong 'khyid ni khong 'byin/ gtu lum ni bzi ba/ gyu ba ni bkur ba/ pho theg che ba ni khengs pa ste lta ba mtho ba'i don/ phog snya che ba ni sran che ba/ rme ba ni smra ba/ rmun po ni blun po/ 'phan pa ni chag pa'am mnyams pa/ chu'i dngo ni chu ngogs/ gri'i dngo ni gri'i so/ khar ba ni yang dag min pa/ 'or 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ 'brus 'gogs ni brtson 'grus/ 'bogs pa ni brgal ba/ 'bog pa ni brgyal ba/ bya rkon ni bya rgya/ gnyig tu ni gcig tu/ blong ba ni rmugs shing song ba/ blo blong ni yi mug gam rig pa mi gsal ba/ blong blong yang zer/ gzhen 'debs dang gzhan bskul ni dran bskul/ chad pa'am bang so ni dur gyi gnas/ phol te ni phan te/ 'ung nas ni 'di nas/ nyid grul ni rigs ngan/ rngad mo ni dmod mo/ rang nyams ni rang bzhin/ 'gran do ni 'gran zla/ yibs su ni dbyibs su/ bla khyad ni dregs pa/ 'ung teng ni 'on kyang / 'or pa ni bor ba/ pha logs ni pha rol/ gyam shing ni rol mo/ cho lo ni rgyan po/ zus nas ni zug nas/ blon 'debs ni chos ston nam zur nas gros 'debs/ gdas pa ni smra ba'am zhus pa'am zhu ba/ sna ru ni na ro/ 'grongs ni rma'i sgo/ mchis brang ni chung ma/ ma drangs pa ni ma dul ba/ gzhongs ni ljongs/ bus pa ni byis pa/ 'jebs pa ni 'grogs pa'am legs pa'am snyan pa/ nan tur ni chad las/ yus te ni bden te/ zha 'bring dang zham 'bring ni zhabs 'bring / rmen ngan ni ltas ngan/ gti ba ni smra ba/ slad bzhin ni phyi bzhin/ gshor ba ni rtsub pa/ gzings pa la'ang /

'phyan pa ni 'khyam pa/ gshor ni snod/ klag cor ni ca co/ shen pa ni bshen pa/ rnyis pa ni rnyings pa/ smye ba ni zhen pa/ le'u gron pa ni lan ldon pa/ 'drag mthil ni lag mthil/ bum bu ni bum chung / rtsig gu ni rtsig pa/ brungs kyang ni kun kyang / re rma ni bud med/ nan thur ni nan tan/ g.yur dang yur ni gnyid/ sgre'u chung ni 'dzag snod/ par tang dang dre'u rngog ni stan khra bo/ smyugs nas ni bcug nas/ dku ste ni lhag ste/ ma la ni kye ma'am kyi 'ud/ ngog go ni non no/ /mdun bdar ba ni mdun nas bstod pa'am mdun du bgyis pa/ thong khor ni gar bu/ lag tub ni sgyogs/ ldongs pa ni long ba/ dmigs bu ni yong khrid/ ngog na ni song na/ mod mi dma' ba dpangs mtho ba'am phra mo ma yin pa/ rnyong ngam byug pa'am skyang nul ni zhal ba/ zhal zhal kyang de nyid/ than skor ni nye skor/ yugs shig ni byugs shig za phod pa ni lto che ba/ ltung rus ni ltung 'bras/ 'dzer to ni zer to/ dugs khang ni khrus khang / dpya ba ni 'phya ba/ snga za ni snga ba/ tshang mang ni nag tshang ngam me khang / khu sha ni sha khu/ tham lag ni man ngag lan kan ni kha khyer ram stegs bu/ gzhags pa ni brgyan pa/ 'drub pa ni 'tshem pa/ drubs pa ni btsems pa/ de mo ni dgos pa/ rnam phyis ni phyis khang pa/ skun bu ni gzhong bu/ ya gang ni rkang rten nam skas ka ci chog ni ci yod/ tha gi ni zhi ba/ rgya khu can ni gcer bu pa/ gzar thag ni dpyang thag slas ni btsun mo'i 'khor/ gyong ral ni sa zhag bshul ni lam/ mod pa ni bden pa/ spyan pa ni byar ba/ chems pa ni 'phrin pa/ mdun khang ngam bkad sa ni 'dug sa/ 'dun pa ni tshogs pa/ tshig gu ni 'bras bu'i snying po/ skyes phran ni dar la bab pa/ lce rten ni brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/ regs pa ni bregs pa/ skyos pa ni nyams pa/ chu 'dal ba ni dal por 'dug pa'i chu/ nyul ba ni bul ba'am 'gor ba/ gzhar ba ni mthun pa/

chan pa ni khye bo'am gri grug ldang sko ska dang bse kha sgo ni seng ge sha ra bha ste seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa'i ming / ched 'ga' ni res 'ga'/ skyo sngogs ni 'khrug pa/ bags kyi ni rim gyi/ nod pa ni len pa'am thob pa/ brla brnyan ni snon pa/ tshang thur ni gos shubs/ brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ brnyas pa ni g.yas pa/ yu bu ni rang re'am bdag cag khom pa ni dal ba/ pho long ni gru gru/ phyag las khom ni ra ro ba/ dgum pa ni gsod pa/ 'gum pa ni 'chi ba/ bkum pa dang gum pa ni bsad pa'am shi ba/ rmed du ni gsol du/ 'khob pa ni ngan pa'am mtha'/ rdzi ni rlung / khrun ring ni mchu ring ngam dkyus ring / brnogs pa ni bsdams pa'am sbas pa/ mnags pa ni bzod pa'am bsran pa/ dral po ni ming po/ che zhe ni a che'am sring mo/ 'byes pa ni mdzes pa'am mtshams phyed pa/ sbu la bab pa ni rung ba/ mi chog ni mi phod/ shing thags ni cog rtsang nan ni btung ba/ 'thams pa ni byams pa/ 'khams pa ni brgyal ba/ sdum mtshes ni khyim mtshes/ dbang thang che ba ni skal ba che ba'am skal pa bzang ba/ ma nangs pa ni ma langs pa/ nangs kyi ni sngon gyi/ g.yer bag ni snang g.yel can/ brlams pa ni bskyod pa/ sgre bo ni sa rjen/ 'od pa ni yod pa/ mig gi rngu ma ni mig gi dri ma'am skyo ma/ sbal du ni dong du/ phyugs phyung ni gzhon nu ma/ snog gzan ni 'khur ba/ bya mo lab ni mchod rdzas/ lan kan ni pu shu/ rgyun lugs ni rgyu 'grul/ g.yar 'dren ni spyan 'dren/ g.yar len ni khas len/ g.yar dam ni dam bca'/ g.yar lam ni mdun/ g.yar khral ni kha khral lam ngo khral/ g.yar tsha ni ngo tsha/ g.yar khams ni sku khams/ g.yar ngo ni gdong / sge'u chung ni 'gro ba/ sge'u gsher ni kha 'dam ste bca' sga dang ro nus cha mthun zhig gi ming / drung ni rtsa ba/ 'gyur byed ni pra chal/ mi ngas ni mi nad dam rim nad/ zhal tshus ni zhal zas/ long bu ni shing tog 'os pa ni gcer bu pa/

rtsen pa ni rtse ba'am rol pa/ bla gab ni steng g.yogs/ thoms shig ni soms shig mthol ba ni smra ba'am mi sbed pa/ bshos pa ni 'khrig pa/ gtam 'dres pa ni phebs par smra ba/ smon 'drin ni grogs po/ ltag 'og ni snga phyi'i gong 'og spun pa ni bstun pa/ thog thog ni dang po/ reg zig ni zin bris/ bon pa ni zlas pa/ ne'u ldang ni na zla/ sgog pa ni sgog skya ste ra su na'am/ la shun/ kun dong ni btsong ste palāṇḍu/ ke'u ni ri sgog hab shang mtshe'u ni dbang lag lig shi wer ni dzā ti ste sna ma'i me tog kru kru tres ni tsi tra ka ja hong ni btsod mdog slad tsha ni mi gtsang ba'am bshang ba/ thob kyis 'jal ba ni thabs kyis gzhan nor 'gugs pa/ sha chags pa ni blo la yod pa'am bab thob yod pa dang 'thug pa'am brling ba/ ngag 'khyal ni 'brel med du smra ba/ kyal ga ni ku re'i tshig bstang ba ni mgon nam grogs/ bstings tshig ni sun 'byin pa'i tshig ste ming ngan pa la mi ya mtshan can ces brjod pa lta bu/ dus po che ni 'dzin pa che ba/ stongs pa ni phan pa'am grogs/ dkor dang ka ca ni nor gyi spyi ming / dkyil che ba ni khong yangs pa/ chu gang ni snying stobs/ bkrabs pa ni mang po'i nang nas 'dams pa/ bskrun pa ni bskyed pa'am btsugs pa/ skrus pa ni gcod pa/ sgrun pa ni 'gran pa/ bskru ba ni gzhan la thabs kyis 'brong pa/ bska ba ni gar ba'am ro'i khyad par/ skyin gor ni gangs sbal lam rtsangs pa/ mi 'gong ba ni mi skrag pa/ dbos pa ni sbos pa/ dngan 'then ni gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi gtod pa/ zil dngar ni bdud rtsi/ bcom bskyungs ni 'jigs nas skad chung ngur smra ba'am kha rog 'dug pa/ man ni tshod dang dus/ 'jungs pa ni zhen chags che ba/ nying sha ni rang gi sha ju po ni rdo/ lag nya ni byin len ma byas par len pa/ nye reg ni khrus/ mchig dang mchig gu ni mas gtun dang yas gtun/ sha kon zhugs pa ni khon yod pa/

mnyel ba ni ngal ba/ phyag brnyan ni 'khor g.yog spyo ba dang brgyad pa ni 'thab pa'am smad pa/ skra brnyen ni skra chab/ sgra brnyan ni brag cha/ gtams pa ni khangs pa'am bcol ba/ bltams pa ni skyes pa'am 'khrungs pa/ rtul phod ni snying stobs che ba/ brtul ni bsdus pa'am 'jam pa/ dgung ni gnam/ mtshan mo/ gdung lo sogs/ gdugs ni nyi ma'am nyin par/ 'khrun ni 'phangs ngam srid/ kho lag ni zheng ngam sboms/ bda' ba ni zhim pa/ 'dren ma ni sna tshogs 'dres ma'am khra bo/ bla brdol ni bla col/ mnag dang mnog chung ni sran dka' dang khe chung ba/ 'phral ba ni dpral ba/ phyang nge ba ni 'jol le ba/ byug ris ni gral/ rtse rgod ni lha 'bangs/ nang byan ni g.yog mtshag bzang ba ni nyam rgyas pa'am yan lag dang nying lag rgyas pa/ mtshal lu ni rting dkar/ 'tshal ma ni zas sam lto/ 'tshal ni shes pa'am 'dod pa/ 'khums pa ni thos pa'am shes pa/ nu rdzi ni nying khu/ gzhes pa ni sdod pa'am bzhugs pa/ bskal ba ni bar chod pa'am rgyang ring ba/ gzhib pa ni 'jib pa/ ma rtabs pa ni mi rings pa/ rlam khyer ni ham khyer/ brtags pa ni gus pa'am sgrin pa/ gsud pa ni sgregs pa/ gshung ba ni ngos kyis skyon brjod pa'am shub bus smod pa/ skyel bdar ni skyel gla/ dri dku ba ni dri mi zhim pa'am dri tsha ba/ 'gong ba ni smad pa/ mngag gzhug dang ci bgyi ni g.yog po/ shin te ma med pa ni snyigs ma med pa'am chud za ba'am nyam chung ba med pa/ sag rtsa skyel ba ni sbungs skyed pa'am dam bca' brtan pa/ skyo ma ni phra ma dang bye ba/ sril ni srog chags mug pa/ skyu rum ni tshod ma/ bya na ni tshod ma'am spags ma/ spun pa ni bsres pa/ spen tog ni rgyan/ spa ba ni mdzes pa'am byin chags pa/ spyoms pa ni ngom pa'am bdag bstod/ la gcan pa ni la'i tshugs pa/ sho gam pa ni yul gyi tshugs pa/ gru btsas pa ni gru tshugs pa/ don mthun ni tshong pa/ 'gron po'ang de nyid/ sta zur ni dpyi mgo

spon pa ni gtong ba/ spun pa ni rdzun pa/ rje btsan ni rje btsun/ dngags ni ngag bla ni rung ngam bzod dam mchog klad ni gong ngam steng / dbyig ni nor/ so sto ni so zing / spyi cer ni spyi ther/ bzlums pa ni bsdus pa/ brjed pa dang rim gro dang btsun par bya ba ni bkur sti dang mchod pa'i ming gi rnam grangs/ bkus te bor ba ni khu ba bton pa'i snyigs lta bu/ chab mi 'tshal ba ni chud mi za ba/ pyid ni dar yol ba'am rgan po/ sle 'dams pa ni mtshan mchad pa/ mtshan par rdol ba ni mo mtshan gyi nad/ spyi bltol che ba ni dpral ko 'thug pa/ dmus pa ni tshi tshad pa/ smeg pa ni nyams dang 'khos ka kha cig tu rtsa ba'am lhag ma/ smrig ni gos tshos ma/ ngur smrig ni gos dmar ser la grags kyang tshos snyigs mas btsos pa'i don yin/ ga gon dang tshon mo steng ni zha nye/ ro nye ni zha nye nag por yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel pa zla zer las bshad/ sgrabs pa ni zas/ btogs pa ni phrogs pa/ go re long ni gad byed pa/ smre zhes pa ni sdug bsngal/ yan lag skyes ni pho mtshan/ rmya ba ni nyams pa/ gtams pa ni bshad pa'am bstan pa/ khud du byas pa mang po'i yin pa bdag nyid gcig pus dbang du byas pa/ dga' 'dun ni skyes pa'am bud med rkyang pa dga' spro la tshogs pa/ tshogs can ma ni smad 'tshong ma'i tshogs la zer ba'ang snang / mnyes pa ni legs pa'am gros mthun pa/ mi bkyig pa ni mi brgyang ba'am myur ba/ spu bsnyal ba ni nyes pa bshags pa'am zhe sdang zhi ba/ spu snyol ba ni lus ngag yid kyi zhe sdang zhi bar byed pa/ chags rgya ni bu lon bda' ba'i dpang rgya ste yi ge bcug pa/ kha phyin pa ni gros mthun pa/ bru ba ni ltogs pa'am bkres pa/ sman btags pa ni phan btags pa/ rnal du phab ste ni gzhan gyi 'tshe ba med par rang dbang du gnas pa/ bze re can ni sran chung ba'am gzhon sha can/ chums pa ni chags pa/ 'tshal ma 'tshal ni zan za ba/

brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ bla na ni smra ba'am zer/ kha dum pa ni 'chams pa'am mthun pa/ che bzhi ni bden dpang / skugs su btsugs pa ni rgyal btsugs pa/ spyos pa ni 'thab pa'am kha smras/ gzhongs spyod pa ni ljongs rgyu ba/ chung pa ni zhing pa/ dus kyis 'chu ba ni dbang gis 'chu ba/ bzang mkhan ni gos bzo ba/ spang ba ni mi 'jigs pa/ 'grong gis 'grong la sbyar ba ni pho mtshan gyis pho mtshan la sbyar ba/ smyugs pa ni bcug pa/ dkre ni pho mtshan gyi tog spogs bgyid pa ni tshong khe ba na rgyag cing mnyam pa dang gyong byung ba na mi rgyag pa dang mod nyo dkon tshong la'ang / kog rtse ni rgya'am rnyi rnyong ngo / /thong to ni rtse mo/ btungs pa ni bsad pa/ skri zhig ni thong zhig bshes gnyen ni yon tan/ dpung tshogs yan lag bzhi rmongs btab bam/ nam sros kyi bar du brongs shig chu lon ni rags/ ma reg tsam du drung du bsnyen te ni nye ba/ gnas nas sbed pa ni gnas nas phyung ba/ nye zho med pa ni legs pa'am skyon med pa'am bkra shis pa la sogs pa ste rgyas par na snga 'gyur gyi gsung rab rnams rgya cher bklags pa las shes par 'gyur gyi mtha' dag pa ni yi ge'i las su che la/ 'on kyang cung zad brjod pas blo gros kyi 'jug par 'phel ba'i thabs su mthong nas/ bcom ldan rig ral dang / dbus pa blo gsal la sogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge las kyang ji ltar rigs par btus shing / dpal ldan bla ma lo chen gyi gsung las 'byung ba'ang bsnan te bris pa'o/ /yang 'dir/ legs sbyar gyi skad zur chag pas brda rnying par 'khrul pa'ang 'ga' zhig snang ste/ ab ces pa chu'i skad dod yin pa dang / mar chung ngu la sto ka zhes pa'ang chung ngu'i skad dod nyid yin pa dang / kol ma zhes pa gzan dron gyi ming du yod pa'ang / kulmāṣa zur chag pa dang / sman dpyad las ni/ mon sran sde'u sran chung la sogs pa btsos nas shing kun la sogs pa sbod du btab pa ni thug pa la 'dod do/

/a ṇu zhes pa chung ngu'am phra mo'i skad dod yin pa la/ a nu zhes grags pa dang / mi khengs pa che ba la mi 'gar po zhes zer ba'ang / garba zhes pa nga rgyal gyi skad dod zur chag dang / mi sgrob che ba zhes pa'ang / ā ṭo pa zhes pa brjid pa'am bsgyings pa zur chag pa dang / kiṅka ra zhes pa ci bgyi ste/ las byed dam pho nya'am g.yog gi skad dod zur chag pas ging pa dang / ging pho ging ming mo zhes grags pa dang / sd+yul zhes pa sbom po dang rags pa dang rgya che ba'i skad dod zur chag pas thul che ba zhes pa dang / dhūli zhes pa zur chag pas rdul zhes pa dang / bhuka zur chag pa bug pa zhes pa dang / brāhmaṇa zhes pa tshangs pa las byung ba ste zur chag pas 'bram ze dang / phal ka zhes pa ri mo'i skad dod zur chag pas 'phal ka dang / kalpā'ang bskal pa zhes pa bod kyi brdar mdzad pa dang / lakṣ+mīkar zhes pa dpa' mdzad de/ zur chag pas legs smin ka ra dang / piṇḍa pa bsod snyoms pa zhes pa ste/ zur chag pas pe nya ba dang / pen da par 'don pa dang / bihār zhes pa gtsug lag khang pa zhes pa ste zur chag pas dbe har dang dpe dkar du bod pa dang / ind+ranīl zhes pa dbang sngon te/ zur chag pas anda rnyil zhes pa dang / amitābha zhes pa 'od dpag med de zur chag pas amidewa dang / aryāwalokita 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes pa zur chag pas ārya pa lo dang / pustaka glegs bam gyi skad dod zur chag pas po ti zhes pa dang / sutradzīwa bu'i 'tsho ba zhes pa zur chag pas 'bo de tsi dang / rudrākṣa zhes pa drag po'i mig ces pa zur chag pas rag sha dang / sindhur zhes pa la khri'i skad dod zur chag pas se 'dur ra dang / kuṅku ma zur chag pa gur kum dang / guggu la zur chag pas gu gul dang / bimba zhes pa sku gzugs kyi skad dod zur chag pas 'bum pa dang / 'bi 'bi zhes pa dang / gañdzir mdzod ldan te/ zur chag pas 'gan 'ji ra dang / na ku la rigs med de zur chag pas ne'u le dang /

patāka zur chag pa ba dan dang / satstshāyā dam pa'i gzugs brnyan te zur chag pas tsha tsha zhes pa dang / muktika grol ba can te/ zur chag pas mu tig dang / kesar zhes pa ral pa yin pa zur chag pas ge sar dang / byañdzan zhes pa tshod ma'am zas spags ma la 'jug pa zur chag pas bya na dang / bheka sbal pa la 'jug pa la mi gcer bur 'dzings pa la sbe ka zhes pa'ang zur chag pa dang / dhik ces pa ngan pa'i skad dod zur chag pas mi glen pa la dig pa dang / sahor zhes pa rgya gar gyi rgyal rigs yan gar ba zhig gi ming zur chag pas za hor zhes pa dang / kaṭor zhes pa snod kyi skad dod zur chag pas ka to ra dang / la hu zhes pa yang ba'am myur ba'i skad dod zur chag pas la mo dang la gor/ mahiṣasar nyal gyi skad dod zur chag pas ma he dang / bzlas pa'i skad dod ja pa dang / dzapita zur chag pas 'dzab ces sngags kyi ming du 'khrul pa dang / trika zhes pa ri mo nyis rim dang khron pa'i mu khyud kyi skad zur chag pas/ prika dang / dgog tu phyin pa ni rgas pa/ go la zlum po'i skad dod go ra zhes pa dang / rin po che du ma phyogs gcig tu bzhu ba gser dmar por grags pa/ dzhaikṣim zhes pa la zi khyim dang / mgrin pa'i skad dod grīb zur chag pas gre ba dang / sgron me'i skad dod ta la la zur chag pas ta la tsam dang / ta la sbyin sogs mtha' yas par snang zhing / yang / kha cig gis legs par sbyar ba'i skad dang / bod skad shan ma phyed par bod skad kyi 'bru bsnan pa mthong ste/ de yang / saindha pa zhes pa rgya mtsho las byung ba ste/ tshwa dang ral gri dang rta sogs la 'jug pas sgra don skabs stobs kyis shes dgos pa la/ sen mo'i brda se gol du 'chad pa dang / a ga ru'i ming gi rnam grangs shim sha pa zhes pa'i shim gyi klad kor nga yig tu klog pa/ bod skad kyi shing du 'khrul nas sha pa'i shing zer ba dang / ri po ta la'i pa yig kha gsum ste/ ri bo ta lar 'don pa dang /

sihla la tshim byed de/ tu ru ka dang ming gcig pa/ bsil la zhes bsil sman du 'don pa dang / pipīlī zhes pa grog ma la 'jug cing de dang 'dra ba'i sman nag po la grog sman pi pi ling zhes pa la'ang / drod sman pi pi ling du 'don dang / shashīraṃ zhes pa gdung dang sku la 'jug pa la/ sha zhes pa bod skad dang / rīraṃ zhes pa ri bsrel gyi don du bzung nas/ gdung nya rī raṃ dang / chu rī raṃ dang / me rī raṃ dang / bi ma la mi tra dri med bshes gnyen zhes pa la bye ma'i nang nas mig bkra ba'i gtam rgyud dang / tu ruṣka zhes pa gar log gi skad dod yin pa ma shes par/ ngan pa tsam gyi don du bsams te bskal pa du ru ka dang / me du ru ka dang / chu du ru ka dang / sa du ru ka sogs zer ba dang / a ti yog shin tu rnal 'byor yin pa'i a ti nyid zab mo'am nying khu lta bu'i don du rlom pas zab tig dang yang tig sogs dang / doha zhes pa mi zad pa'i skad la gnyis la rgod pa dang / nā ro pa zhes pa rtsa bshad pa ces pa'i skad dod la/ a na na dang ro ru zhes pa dang / tai lo pa til brdung la/ te na te zer lo zhes mang du 'chad snang ba ni brjod pa'i lam las 'das pa lta bur snang mod/ shin tu mi mkhas pas smras pa ni dgag par yang mi ldang ngo / /zhes mkhas pa dag gsung zhing phal cher ni mkhas pa snga ma dag gis bkag pa ltar ro/ /kha cig tu rgya nag gi brda rnying du 'khrul ba snang ste/ blon po la phying sang zhes pa dang / dngul rdzus ma la ha yang ha zhes pa dang / rgya la hung la dang / gzhan yang grum rtse dang / cog rtse dang / lugs rgyu mtshan bsnyad pa la g.yang rtse zhes pa dang / phing chang dang gzan gyi ming la zin gzan dang / cing phing dang / as man gur gum sogs mang du snang la/ rgyal po'i zhal la gser zhal dang / bang chen la gsar yig pa dang / gser skyems sogs kyang rgya nag gi brdar snang zhing / la la hor gyi brdar yang snang ste/

btsun pa la pag shi dang / dbang che ba la dar kha che dang / dar rgyan byin sogs mang la/ kha cig bon po'i brdar yod de/ legs pa la gnam mchod pa dang / mi shi ba la gnam du gshegs pa dang / bsod nams che ba la gnam gyis bskos pa zhes pa dang / dbang che ba la gnam sa'i bdag ces pa sogs shin tu mang zhing / kha cig ni bod skad nyid ma dag pas brda rnying du 'khrul pa'ang yod de/ kuṇḍali'i bod skad bdud rtsi thab sbyor la/ bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang / utstshuṣma'i bod skad/ khol ba la chol pa dang / g.yar dam la yal gam dang / rma bya'i ming mdongs mtha' can la mdongs thal can zhes pa dang / gta' ma la gte pa/ spyon zhes pa la byon zhes pa dang / zhag gi sor ris zhes sor mo gsum gyi ri mo la zhag gi zo ris zhes pa dang / dring zhes pa ni ne la dang / pratyaya bsgyur pa gzhan gyis 'dren pa'am rkyen gyi don yin pa dang / bka' drin zhes pa/ prasād bsgyur ba'ang ma phyad pa dang / mi blo ba sral can la/ blo ral zhes pa mtha' yas la/ kha cig ni bod skad nyid la zhe sar sbyar ba ma go bar brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang snang ste/ chu la chab dang / me la zhugs dang / rlung la bser bu dang / sa la dog ma dang / rdo la gor ma dang / gnam la dgung dang / gnam lo la dgung lo dang / bden pa la mod pa dang / bzhugs pa la gzhes pa dang / lto ba la phyal dang / chab shog chab srid/ chab 'bangs/ chab sgo sogs kyang zhe sa'i tshig go /yang rgya rna ru can sogs brda rnying du bshad snang yang / de dag ni gab tshig tu mdzad pa yin gyi brda rnying min no/ /yang la la ni zhang zhung gi skad du snang ste/ sle tres dang phye ma la tras sam dang / zhib mo la cur ni sa sogs sman dpyad kyi skabs su mtha' yas pa snang ba dang / der ni legs zur chag pa'ang mang ste/ sūkṣ+mai la zhes pa e la phra mo'i skad dod la/ sug mel du grags pa sogs mtha' yas mod kyang yi ge mang ba'i 'jigs pas spros pa bsdu'o/

/'on kyang 'di tsam zhig brjod pa min na tshig ma go bas don la 'khrul pa shin tu mang po mthong ba de dag slar yang gya tshoms su gyur te/ gsung rab kyi tshig don phyin ci log tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'chad pa dang rtsom pa dang zhu chen gyi grwar mchi ba dag gis gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par 'di tsam zhig mi shes su mi rung bar byas te gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa chud mi gson pa la bslab par bya'o/ /zhes 'doms par byed do/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mnyam med rgyal ba'i bka'/ /dgongs 'grel bcas pa 'gyur ro cog rnams kyi/ /gsar rnying brda yi khyad par mtha' yas pa/ /chos spyan mnga' ba'i 'jig rten mig rnams kyis/ /spyod yul min na bdag ltas ci zhig rtogs/ /de slad 'khrul pa'i cha rnams tshig dang don/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i mkhas pas bzod mdzad de/ /legs par bshad pa'i bdud rtsis mnyes par mdzod/ /lhag bsam dag pa'i dge legs ni/ /zla zer 'thungs pa'i kundas kyang / /mtshon pa min nges rgyal ba'i bstan/ /'khrul med yun du gnas gyur cig /ces bya ba 'di yang gdong ngan zhes bya ba'i lo/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ga' zhig gis zhal ta phebs pa dang / shrīmanma ṇi kas 'phral du bskul zhing yi ge'i rkyen sbyar ba la brten nas/ skyogs ston gyis reg zig tu bkod pa'o// //gaṅgalaṃ// shubhaṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 zhwa lu skyogs ston/ dag yig li shi'i gur khang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
